subject.title: feat(gateway): durable user profiles with email aliases and avatars

question: Should durable profiles be created automatically when an authenticated gateway identity first connects, as the PR description promises, or should the identity train define and document a different explicit profile-provisioning workflow before these public APIs land?
rationale: The branch introduces durable state and public APIs but currently provides no production creation path; choosing the permanent identity lifecycle affects later presence and attribution behavior as well as migration expectations.

options.title: Create profiles on authenticated first use
options.body: Wire the existing resolver into the authenticated connection path so the profile and alias exist before `users.*` administration or downstream identity enrichment uses them.

options.title: Adopt explicit provisioning
options.body: Add a deliberate admin creation/provisioning API and documentation, then revise the PR description and tests so profiles are not claimed to be created on first login.

recommendation.title: Create profiles on authenticated first use
recommendation.body: Wire the existing resolver into the authenticated connection path so the profile and alias exist before `users.*` administration or downstream identity enrichment uses them.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied canonical identity-program issue and adjacent merged PRs place this lifecycle choice in the same feature train.
